'I was young in your years, but old in mine: 13. I was out on a normal scavenging mission with some of my critters. We happened upon a dead humanoid body, and began to prepare to move it. Suddenly several pairs of eyes peered out from the darkness. A pack of rats had come to scavenge from the body. They were large, must larger than expected.
